description: This satellite image depicts an _Eucalyptus_ sp. plantation located in Southern Spain, specifically in Lepe (Huelva). The imagery was acquired on 2011-08-06 by the Spot 5 satellite, utilising a Near Infrared (NIR) band combination, resulting in a resolution of 2.5 metres. The copyright is attributed to CNES 2011© Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image. The landscape reveals distinct land cover features: dense _Eucalyptus_ plantations are prominently displayed in various shades of deep red, characteristic of vegetation in NIR imagery. Within these areas, visible rows indicate planted stands and a network of linear features likely represents forest tracks and firebreaks. Adjacent to these plantations, lighter green and blueish areas suggest other types of vegetation or less dense forest. Mottled brown and grey sections indicate sparsely vegetated areas, bare ground, or agricultural fields. A winding natural feature, likely a river or stream, traverses the central portion of the image, and small dark blue water bodies are also visible. The visible patterns suggest ongoing forest management activities, including potential clear-cutting or harvesting.
